ops.title: Avoid whole live-card state rewrites for small daemon updates
ops.description: Owner: root. Natural observation on Nov 12 20:53 Pacific saw live-cards.json atomically replaced at unchanged size 5,866,895 bytes while read-cache.db and its WAL stayed unchanged. Evidence: /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/cost-retro-20261102/cc-slack-natural-15s-files.json. Next: inspect liveCards.save/saveFile and callers in cmd/cc-slack/livecards.go, isolate necessary versus redundant persistence, implement the simplest bounded reduction preserving card state durability. This is independent of the empty-poll cache fix; attribution of all daemon writes remains unproven.

ops.text: Root cause and bounded persistence fix reviewed, merged, officially released and installed; affected semantics pass unchanged CI.
Natural process IO and named card-state writes measured after activation without synthetic traffic; protected sessions preserved.
